title: The silent-undo check clears a line a merge lost when the head holds it again, or its remedy names the trailer as the only way out
why: For a merge commit that lost a line, lint/check_silent_undo.py prints "put the work back, or add the trailer". A later commit that puts the line back does not clear the refusal, because the check reads the merge against its parent. Lane #2378 lost a review round to it.
note: Coordinator (13:07 CST Nov 9): a possible false-alarm remedy, not a hold. Two fixes: the check clears a lost line that the head holds again, or the remedy names the trailer as the only way out for a merge. Not folded into lane-lint-before-push: that step moves the check earlier, and this one changes what the check says. Done: cc75a70f2 and 9dc4efda5 on main (2026-11-09): lint/check_silent_undo.py unrestored() clears a line the head holds again (triage reader agent, Explore Sonnet audit, read of origin/main 0e6509a96, 06:03 CST Nov 10).
